description: Deletes a question bank or ONE of its items - "target" says which, and nothing else deletes either. target "bank" removes the bank and every item it holds (its tags cleaned up exactly as question_bank_tag(action: "remove") does), and is rejected with QUESTION_BANK_INTERDEPENDENCY while a Riddle of the bank's own project still references it - counting the DRAFT and, on a published Riddle, the live version too, so a block removed from a draft does not release the bank until that Riddle is republished; read "deletingABank" in riddle://reference/question-bank/overview before deleting one. target "item" takes questionBankItemId and touches nothing else: on a never-published item the delete is immediate and permanent, on a published one it only leaves the DRAFT - a live Riddle keeps drawing that item until question_bank_manage(action: "publish") purges it, and question_bank_discard_changes brings it back until then. Both are permanent for the caller: there is no trash and no restore. Rejected for a public template id - a template is copied with question_bank_manage(action: "duplicate"), never deleted. Needs full access: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

questionBankId.description: The ID of the question bank to delete, or of the bank the item belongs to.

questionBankItemId.description: The ID of the item to delete, as returned by question_bank_get_items or question_bank_item(action: "add"). Required for target "item", rejected for "bank".

target.description: What to delete: "bank" (the bank itself and every item in it) or "item" (one question of it).

name: question_bank_delete
